summary_1line: Sugriva explains to Rama that his knowledge of the world came from fleeing Bali across every direction of the earth before taking refuge at Rishyamuka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sugriva flees across forests and mountains with Bali raging behind him, the landscape blurring like a spinning firebrand.
Foaming blood gushes from the dark cave entrance while Sugriva, terrified, seals it with a massive boulder believing Bali dead.
Hanuman points toward the hermitage on Rishyamuka Mountain, explaining the sage Matanga’s curse that keeps Bali away.
